eas_text: A civil authority has issued A CHILD ABDUCTION EMERGENCY for the following counties or areas: Florida; at 2:16 PM on JUL 27, 2026 Effective until 4:16 PM. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: A Florida AMBER Alert has been issued for Juliet Arioso, a white female, 13 years old, 5 feet 3 inches tall, 90 pounds, brown hair and brown eyes, last seen in the area of the 9100th block of Southwest 27th Avenue in Ocala, Florida. The child may be in the company of Jason Castillo, a white-hispanic male, 5 feet 10 inches tall, 190 pounds, brown hair and green eyes. They may be traveling in a 2021, red Hyundai Santa Fe, FL tag number 77ERLW. They may be travelling southbound. If located, DO NOT APPROACH. Contact law enforcement immediately. If you have any information on the whereabouts of this child please contact the Marion County Sheriff's Office at 352-732-9111 or 911. #FLAMBER.
